'''Kozzel Qwok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]], who worked as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Qwok was the leader of a Pacithhip smuggling gang and flew the modified [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Neebray Manta]]''. During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Republic suspected Qwok and his gang of having links to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], so they spent several months trying to find him.
